about: Golden claims for the Ratecard judge. Written, hashed and timestamped before the first run (golden.lock.json). Scored on the one label, the only thing validators compare. Each golden claim is run three times to show the ladder is stable. H1 to H3 are held out: no expected label, run once, never used to tune the prompt, their labels are reported exactly as they come out.
card: eval/kiln.json, opened for the run as 'Kiln eval ladder' with the prices divided by 100 and a review window of 0, so the pool lasts; the labels do not depend on the prices.
